title: Education Resource MCP stable error codes
x-stability: Codes are append-only within v2 and existing v1 code meanings remain unchanged.

x-error-codes.meaning: The request fails schema-independent semantic validation.
The requested contract major or version is unsupported.
The flow_id is unknown or inaccessible in the trusted context.
The operation is not valid in the current Flow stage.
The resource_id is unknown or inaccessible.
The resource was not in the referenced presented set.
The resource is not in the saved Selection.
The presented or selection version is stale.
The plan_id is unknown or inaccessible.
The download Plan expired and must be prepared again.
The download Plan has already been consumed or cancelled.
Explicit user confirmation is required before the action.
The confirmation token is invalid, expired, or belongs to another Plan.
An idempotency key was reused with a different canonical request.
The job_id is unknown or inaccessible.
The Job is already terminal or cannot be cancelled.
The asset_id is unknown or inaccessible.
The Asset is not validated or its Job did not succeed.
The requested archive metadata conflicts with an existing committed record.
A configured source platform is temporarily unavailable.
The operation completed partially and includes per-item failures.
Legitimate user or platform authorization is required.
A source, action, format, quota, or access policy denied the operation.
The service or source platform rate-limited the operation.
The target protocol, host, address, or network class is blocked.
A redirect target failed protocol, host, or address policy.
Declared or streamed bytes exceeded the effective limit.
The declared content type is not allowed for the Plan.
The downloaded bytes failed real-format or integrity validation.
The controlled temporary, asset, database, or archive storage is unavailable.
An unexpected internal failure occurred without exposing sensitive details.
The referenced Flow task version is stale.
The result_set_id is unknown, inaccessible, or belongs to another Flow.
The ResultSet cannot be used in its current state.
The presentation_id is unknown, inaccessible, or belongs to another Flow.
The presented_version is stale or does not belong to the Presentation.
A selected position is outside the authoritative ordered Presentation.
The supplied selection_digest does not match the current Selection.
The Plan binding tuple does not match the current Presentation and Selection.
The download failed because of an upstream transport or source error.
The download Job stopped because cancellation was requested.
A static capability descriptor failed schema, digest, or compatibility validation.
No declared capability covers the requested platform, resource type, scope, or representation.
The declared capability is not loaded, healthy, authorized, or otherwise ready in the current deployment.
The selected representation or provider scope does not match the capability bound to the Plan.
The descriptor, provider, inspector, or readiness version changed and requires re-resolution.
The policy or rights eligibility decision expired before the action was executed.
A current eligibility decision is required before the requested action.
The current policy profile blocks the capability, source, representation, or action.
The selected Provider cannot execute the scope or representation bound to the Plan.
The declared Provider is unavailable or failed its readiness check.
A landing, metadata, or other non-primary representation cannot be used as a primary download item.
The candidate Resolution or source fingerprint is stale and must be inspected again.
The actual Provider outcome does not match the capability-aware Plan item binding.
A server-owned authority payload failed bounded semantic or persistence validation; raw validator strings are not exposed.
A Plan or persisted authority fact no longer matches its bound descriptor, readiness, resolution, representation, or eligibility evidence.
More than one capability descriptor matches the requested platform, resource type, scope, and strategy.
The descriptor digest changed after preparation and the resource must be resolved and prepared again.
The capability registry version or digest changed after preparation and requires fresh authority evidence.
The requested or returned acquisition strategy does not match the declared capability binding.
The selected capability does not declare an executable acquisition strategy.
The trusted Flow or policy context required to revalidate eligibility is missing.
Policy, rights, authorization, or eligibility facts changed after preparation.
The loaded Provider identity or version no longer matches the prepared binding.
Deployment readiness changed after preparation and the capability is no longer ready.
The deployment readiness snapshot expired before the action was executed.
The readiness observation is not bound to a validated capability registry snapshot.
Multiple representations are available and no unambiguous server-owned representation binding was selected.
The resolved representation changed after preparation and must be inspected and prepared again.
The selected representation_id is not present in the authoritative Resolution.
The selected representation is not a concrete materializable primary resource.
A concrete server-owned representation selection is required for the requested action.
The observed representation or Provider scope changed after preparation.
The observed source fingerprint changed after preparation.
The executable acquisition strategy changed after preparation.
The service could not observe the source fingerprint required for an authoritative binding.
The requested platform feature is explicitly unsupported by the current declared capability.
A platform signature required for a legitimate request could not be produced by the configured signer.
